text.p: Micronics Computers Inc said on Friday it will consolidate its European organization, merging some into single offices, to be more aggressive in its delivery of computer system boards, server technology and multimedia peripherals.
Micronics said it hired Etienne Finet as the Director International Sales to head the remade organization.
A spokeswoman said there will be no job cuts in the reorganization.

"The streamlining of our European operations will enable us to increase our competitive position in the marketplace, and to provide better service and support to our customers," said Shanker Munshani, chief executive of Micronics.
Micronics' European operations will consist of Micronics UK, Micronics Germany, a manufacturer's representative called InfoTrade, located in France, and master distributors.
Micronics UK will manage sales and marketing in the United Kingdom and will act as the Central European Dispatch Center.
InfoTrade will oversee all sales and marketing in France, Spain, Portugal, Greece and North Africa.
Micronics Germany will be responsible for business in Germany, Switzerland, Italy, Austria and Eastern Europe.
